stem:
Shreya finds a laboratory thermometer. Its scale runs from −10 °C to 110 °C. Between the 0 °C and 10 °C marks there are 5 equal small divisions.

What are the range and the value of the smallest division?

options.text: Range −10 °C to 110 °C; each of the 5 divisions measures 10 °C.
Smallest division is 10 °C; the printed numbers go up in tens.

teacher.key_rationale: Range is the marked ends. 10 °C / 5 divisions = 2 °C.
